question_text: Given a stream of integers, design a data structure that calculates the median in O(1) time.
Implement an LRU Cache with O(1) get and put operations using doubly linked lists and hash maps.
Design Google Docs real-time collaborative text editor using Operational Transformation or CRDTs.
Find the shortest path in a weighted directed graph where weights represent latency between data centers.
Explain how multi-head self-attention works mathematically and how query, key, value matrices interact.
How does Borg/Kubernetes schedule containers across node pools while ensuring anti-affinity and fault isolation?
Tell me about a time you worked on a project with ambiguous requirements and how you defined the scope.
Implement a Virtualized List in React from scratch to render 100,000 items at 60 FPS.
Design a Distributed File System like Azure Blob Storage with chunking, replication, and high durability.
Find the lowest common ancestor in a binary tree without parent pointers.
Write a SQL query using window functions (ROW_NUMBER / DENSE_RANK) to find top 3 earners in each department.
Describe a conflict you had with a teammate regarding technical architecture and how you reached consensus.
Design Amazon's shopping cart service with high availability, handling transient disconnects and race conditions.
Given a matrix representing an Amazon fulfillment warehouse with obstacles, find the minimum distance to deliver items.
Design an in-memory lock manager for distributed transactions across AWS DynamoDB partitions.
Explain the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing and when you would use AWS ALB vs NLB.
Tell me about a time you invented a simple solution to an otherwise complex problem (Invent and Simplify).
Give an example of a tough decision you made where you had to disagree and commit.
Implement `Promise.allSettled` and `Promise.all` polyfills handling rejection, non-promises, and empty arrays.
Given an undirected social graph, find all friends-of-friends who are not currently direct connections.
Design Instagram Stories feed with media caching, TTL expiration, and high write fan-out.
Serialize and deserialize a binary tree into a compact string representation.
How do you mitigate data drift and concept drift in a real-time recommendation feed model?
Explain memory layout of a process: stack, heap, data segments, and memory leaks detection.
Design Apple Push Notification service (APNs) handling millions of persistent TLS connections concurrently.
Explain how the browser rendering pipeline works: DOM tree, CSSOM, Render Tree, Layout, and Paint.
Implement a Token Bucket rate limiter in Go / Python with atomic operations and thread safety.
Explain how Anycast BGP routing directs user traffic to the nearest Cloudflare edge PoP.
Implement a basic DNS packet parser handling A records and CNAME queries according to RFC 1035.
How does TLS 1.3 0-RTT handshake work and what are the replay attack security implications?
Explain React Server Components vs Server-Side Rendering (SSR) vs Client Components in Next.js App Router.
Build a custom React hook `useDebouncedCallback` with cancellation and immediate flush capabilities.
How would you design a global edge caching network with Instant Invalidation and stale-while-revalidate?
Given an existing payments codebase with 3 failing unit tests, identify the bugs and refactor the code (Stripe Bug Hunt).
Design an idempotent payment processing API that guarantees transactions are never executed twice even with network retries.
Implement an in-memory double-entry bookkeeping ledger with debit and credit balance invariants.
Why do you want to work at Stripe and what is your favorite API documentation experience?
Machine Coding: Design and implement an in-memory Pub-Sub message broker with topic subscriptions and offset tracking.
How do database isolation levels (Read Committed vs Repeatable Read vs Serializable) prevent dirty reads and phantom reads?
Design an automated payment reconciliation engine comparing bank statement settlements against merchant orders.
Design an order matching engine for a stock exchange using price-time priority queues.
Explain why PostgreSQL connection pooling (e.g. PgBouncer) is essential for handling thousands of concurrent trading requests.
How would you stream and render real-time market depth data (100 ticks per second) in the browser without freezing the UI?
Machine Coding: Design a Flash Sale booking system with limited coupons and concurrent checkouts.
Explain how Kafka ensures message ordering within a partition and what happens during consumer rebalancing.
Design high-availability distributed locks using Redis Redlock vs Zookeeper/Etcd consensus.
Find the maximum subarray sum with at least K elements in O(N) time.
Design an ETA estimation service that matches delivery partners to restaurant orders in real time.
Given a grid of city blocks, find the number of unique shortest paths between two points avoiding traffic blocks.
Design a restaurant discovery search engine with geo-distance filters, cuisine tags, and rating aggregations.
Machine Coding: Build an in-memory Ride Sharing application with driver onboard, ride request, and fare calculation.
Explain the CAP theorem and describe which trade-offs Cassandra makes vs relational databases.
Design Git's object model: blobs, trees, commits, and tags with SHA-1 content-addressable storage.
Given a Git commit history represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), find the merge-base between two commits.
Design GitHub Actions workflow execution engine with ephemeral runners and secure secret injection.
Explain how container image registries store and deduplicate OCI layers using content-addressable digests.
Build a drag-and-drop Kanban board component supporting column reordering and card state synchronization.
Explain the 5 core Atlassian values and describe a scenario where you demonstrated 'Open Company, No Bullshit'.
Design a Quad-Tree spatial data structure to rapidly query 50,000 vector shapes on an infinite 2D canvas.
Explain Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) and how state-based vs operation-based CRDTs resolve concurrent edits.
Design the block data model for Notion supporting nested blocks, rich text formatting, and permission inheritance.
Design an HTTP collection runner engine that executes requests sequentially, passes environment variables, and evaluates test assertions.
Explain GraphQL query execution: parsing, validation, AST generation, and resolving fields using DataLoader to prevent N+1 queries.
Write a program to validate nested brackets and mathematical operators in an arithmetic expression without using regex or stacks.
Explain the four pillars of Object-Oriented Programming (Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, Polymorphism) with real-world examples.
What is the difference between TRUNCATE, DELETE, and DROP in relational databases?
Explain Linux cgroups and namespaces (pid, net, mnt, ipc) and how the container runtime configures them.
Write an algorithm in C/Python to detect memory leaks and verify reference cycle garbage collection.
Explain how the Event Loop handles Microtasks (Promises, MutationObserver) vs Macrotasks (setTimeout, requestAnimationFrame).
